name: African Americans
overview: The Scriptures acknowledge the distinct identity of the Ethiopian, highlighting the unchangeable nature of his skin as a metaphor for inherent traits (Jeremiah 13:23). God's promises to His people include blessings and exaltation when they obey His commandments (Deuteronomy 28:1), contrasted with warnings of foreign nations coming against them (Deuteronomy 28:49). Believers are empowered by the Holy Spirit to be witnesses to all nations, extending the gospel message to the ends of the earth (Acts 1:8). These passages collectively affirm God's sovereign plan for all peoples and the call for faithful witness across diverse nations.
